name: moonlet
description: Open-source orbs: durable pi-durable agent threads whose tools run in self-hosted, pausable machines

scripts.build:orb: bun build src/orb-main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile dist/moonlet-linux-x64 && bun build src/orb-main.ts --compile --minify --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/moonlet-linux-arm64
